items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: Theresa Johnson. Theresa or something, I thought it was Theresa. Yeah.

ctx.x: No it wasn't Johnson because that wasn't his mother's name. Jefferson, that's the grandmother of Jefferson. I just used to say his uncle Hendry, I forgot his name was Jefferson or what.
I can't remember his mother's name though. Maria Theresa was her first name.
Theresa Johnson. Theresa or something, I thought it was Theresa. Yeah.
